|lore=Adopted by Bail Organa. Former senator of Alderaan. Natural '''leader'''. Helped steal the Death Star plans. A key figure in the Rebel Alliance.
|game_text='''Agendas''': justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.
